meta.desc: CRYPTO NOVA AI is a free app: AI watches the crypto market around the clock, shows trades with an entry, a stop and a reason, answers your questions and teaches you from zero.
hero.sub: CRYPTO NOVA AI studies the market around the clock, picks the trades that passed its checks and explains each one in plain words. You watch, learn and decide for yourself.
hero.note: Free: no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. Your money always stays with you.
hero.k1: coins watched by AI every minute
hero.k3: AI never takes a day off
why.h2: Understanding crypto is easier than it looks
why.lead: You don't need to be a trader. The system does the heavy lifting, and you get a clear result — in one app.
why.1.p: What's happening with bitcoin and other coins — without complex charts or jargon.
why.2.p: Every trade comes with an entry, a stop, a target and an explanation of why the system chose it.
why.3.p: The AI assistant answers any crypto question in plain words — by text or voice.
why.4.p: Watch the public portfolio live and run your own demo portfolio with no risk.
why.5.p: 52 short lessons with quizzes: from the first steps to a cold wallet.
why.6.t: Save a little at a time
why.6.p: A bitcoin piggy bank: a small amount on a schedule — and you see how much you've saved.
why.free: Free · no subscriptions · your money stays with you
ai.lead: NOVA AI turns the work of the whole system into one clear result and talks to you in plain language — like a friend who knows crypto.
ai.s1.p: Every minute: prices and volumes of {n} coins, news and blockchain data.
ai.s2.p: Every night it tries hundreds of trading ideas on many years of market history.
ai.s3.p: Every forecast is recorded in advance and checked against what happened. What didn't work is dropped.
ai.s4.p: It gives a trade with an entry, a stop and a reason, and answers questions — by text or voice, in 5 languages.
nova.p: Pick a question and NOVA will answer. In the app you can ask anything, by text or voice.
eng.lead: Like a team that never sleeps: each engine does its part and passes the result on, and NOVA AI brings it all together into one answer. Tap an engine to see what it does.
eng.flow.cap: Hundreds of coins go in — only those that pass every check reach the portfolio.
eng.scan.what: Watches prices and volumes of {n} coins around the clock and checks every open trade once a minute.
eng.scan.why: Market changes are spotted within minutes — you don't have to sit at the charts.
eng.lab.s: Finds and tests new ideas every night
eng.lab.what: Comes up with hundreds of trading rules and tests them on many years of market history — crypto, gold, oil and indices.
eng.lab.why: Only ideas that survived the test of history make it to trades — not guesses.
eng.conv.what: The best rules from the lab first run on virtual money at real prices. The weak ones are dropped.
eng.conv.why: A new strategy proves itself without risk first — and only then goes to work.
eng.risk.what: Limits the size of each trade and the total risk of the account. When the market is dangerous, it cuts the load or pauses.
eng.risk.why: Every trade has a stop, and the total risk is capped by limits set in advance.
eng.port.what: Splits the portfolio between spot, futures and other sources, and changes the shares when the market changes.
eng.port.why: The money isn't in one basket — the portfolio adapts to the market.
eng.log.what: Each forecast is recorded before the outcome is known and checked against the facts later. The past can't be quietly rewritten.
eng.log.why: Honest results: you see both the wins and the mistakes.
eng.core.s: Brings the six engines together into one answer
eng.core.what: Takes the results of all engines and gives one decision: a trade with an entry, a stop and a reason — and explains it in plain words, by text or voice.
eng.core.why: You get a clear, ready conclusion — not raw data.
live.foot: Virtual account, real market prices. Past results don't guarantee future ones. Not financial advice.
live.cta.t: Create your own demo portfolio in the app
live.cta.p: Any amount, free. The system runs it at real prices, and you learn without risk.
app.lead: Trades with explanations, the public portfolio, the NOVA AI assistant, a piggy bank and 52 lessons. Free on iPhone and iPad, Android coming soon.
app.caption: Swipe the screens right on the phone. The numbers on them are demo data.
piggy.h2: Save in bitcoin, little by little
how.lead: No subscriptions, no hassle: you watch and learn, you decide, and we earn from the exchange — not from you.
how.s1.p: Free on iPhone and iPad. No subscriptions, no purchases.
how.s2.p: The public portfolio live, your own demo portfolio, 52 lessons and NOVA AI, which answers any question. Demo money is virtual — nothing to lose.
how.s3.p: If you want, you trade on your own account on an exchange that works in your country. The money always stays with you: CRYPTO NOVA has no access to it.
how.s4.t: We earn from the exchange, not from you
how.s4.p: The exchange shares part of its usual fee with CRYPTO NOVA. It costs you nothing: same fees, same terms.
final.p: Free on iPhone and iPad. The engines are already running.
